0022600148.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-2, 1st in the Southeast, 5th in the East) are hosting the Philadelphia 76ers (4-1, 1st in the Atlantic, 2nd in the East) in the Hornets' seventh game of the season, with Charlotte coming off a loss while Philadelphia has won its last game. Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Kylan Boswell are out for Charlotte, while Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, Jabari Walker, Jaylen Brown and Tacko Fall are out for Philadelphia. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Hornets lost 1-2, including a 118-114 loss in Charlotte on March 28, 2026.
